data.title: The video highlights the integration of the Mixtra
data.content:
## Summary
The video highlights the integration of the Mixtral 8x7B Mixture of Experts model into the Brave browser, replacing the previous Llama 2 70B model for its AI assistant, Brave Leo. It demonstrates how this open-source model provides high-performance, privacy-focused AI capabilities including code generation, web page summarization, and contextual chatting directly within the browser.

## Key Points
- Brave has upgraded its AI assistant, Leo, from Llama 2 to the Mixtral 8x7B model.
- Mixtral is integrated into three areas: the Leo sidebar, Code LLM in Brave Search, and the address bar.
- The model is a Sparse Mixture of Experts (MoE) which is more efficient than standard dense models.
- Brave hosts the models locally to maintain user privacy, differentiating itself from companies using OpenAI APIs.
- Capabilities include summarizing YouTube videos, answering programming questions with code blocks, and chatting with webpage content.
- Mixtral 8x7B is positioned as an open-source equivalent to GPT-3.5 Turbo in terms of performance.

## AI Concepts
Sparse Mixture of Experts (MoE), Transformer architecture, Token-based processing, Large Language Models (LLM), Open-source vs. Proprietary AI, Inference rate limits, Model confidence (Top K/Top P)
